gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests {@link DiscordianDate#until(java.time.temporal.Temporal, TemporalUnit)}: the amount of time, measured in a single {@link TemporalUnit}, between two Discor
ADDED i2: Same date is always zero distance, and the result is symmetric for a swapped range.
ADDED i3: Whole units are truncated towards zero: a partial week/month/etc. counts as zero.
ADDED i4: There is only one Discordian era, so any two dates are zero eras apart.
ADDED i5: St. Tib's Day (month 0, dom 0) in days: it falls between dom 59 and dom 60 of month 1.
ADDED i6: St. Tib's Day in weeks: it is outside the week structure, so it does not advance a week.
ADDED i7: St. Tib's Day in months: it counts as part of the first month for month arithmetic.
ADDED i8: St. Tib's Day in years: it counts as part of its own year for year arithmetic.
